BiblicalUsage: Chub appears once, in Ezekiel 30:5, among the nations that will fall with Egypt by the sword. It was a people allied with Egypt, probably in North Africa.
TheologicalSignificance: What convinces me is that the one-line mention still preaches: nations that league themselves with Egypt's pride fall with Egypt, and no alliance saves a people God has judged.
